direction: Restore reliable request handling and then reduce support friction.
ordering: A customer-impacting retry defect precedes a convenience improvement.
closure: Service owner verifies accepted behavior in production; task counts do not prove closure.
priority_policy: Customer blockers P0; confirmed outcomes P1; unvalidated convenience P2. Source policy applies.

selection.rationale: Retain the existing flow view and single document; no new sprint, version batch, phase or event is needed for the current horizon.

context.constraints: Continuous arrivals; no release batch or fixed iteration; policy limits active work to two items

flow.policy: Pull when active WIP is below the team limit of two; start at In progress and finish after verified production delivery.
flow.expectation: Unknown: insufficient historical cycle-time samples; no service-level commitment established.
flow.metrics: Track WIP, throughput, work-item age and cycle time; measured baselines are not yet available.
